title: Visa TAP alternative path: paid content with HTTP 402 and a browsingIOU
summary: The merchant asks for payment for a resource with HTTP 402. The agent retries with a payment container that holds a signed browsingIOU. The merchant checks the IOU against its 402 data and the signature, then grants access expecting the funds at settlement, which TAP does not define.

steps.label: Signed GET for a paid resource

payload.content:
GET /reviews/123 HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example
Signature-Input: sig2=("@authority" "@path");created=1767225600;keyid="agent-key-1";alg="Ed25519";expires=1767225900;nonce="bm9uY2UtcGxhY2Vob2xkZXI";tag="agent-browser-auth"
Signature: sig2=:c2lnbmF0dXJlLXBsYWNlaG9sZGVy:

steps.label: 402 with invoiceId, amount and CAID
steps.detail: TAP does not define the format of the 402 response; it only says it carries an invoice id, an amount and a card acceptor id.

steps.label: Retry with agenticPaymentContainer.browsingIOU
steps.detail: The IOU repeats the invoice data and names the acquirer, the page URI, a sequence counter and the agent's payment service, signed with the agent key. The retry is a new request with a fresh nonce. TAP does not say how the container travels on a GET; it is shown here as a body for illustration.

payload.content:
GET /reviews/123 HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example
Content-Type: application/json
Signature-Input: sig2=("@authority" "@path");created=1767225660;keyid="agent-key-1";alg="Ed25519";expires=1767225960;nonce="bm9uY2UtaW91LXJldHJ5";tag="agent-payer-auth"
Signature: sig2=:cGF5ZXItc2lnbmF0dXJlLXBsYWNlaG9sZGVy:

{
  "agenticPaymentContainer": {
    "nonce": "bm9uY2UtaW91LXJldHJ5",
    "browsingIOU": {
      "invoiceId": "inv-0001",
      "amount": "0.25",
      "cardAcceptorId": "caid-placeholder",
      "acquirerId": "aid-placeholder",
      "uri": "https://shop.example/reviews/123",
      "sequenceCounter": "1",
      "paymentService": "example-payment-service",
      "kid": "agent-key-1",
      "alg": "PS256",
      "signature": "placeholder"
    },
    "kid": "agent-key-1",
    "alg": "PS256",
    "signature": "placeholder"
  }
}

steps.label: Match IOU to the 402 and verify
steps.detail: The merchant must check that the IOU data matches its 402 response and that the signature is valid.

steps.label: 200 with the resource
steps.detail: Access granted on the expectation that funds arrive at settlement.

steps.label: Settlement (not specified)
steps.detail: How and when the IOU is settled, and who bears a default, is not defined in TAP.
